description.subtitle: FC Barcelona x Kobe Bryant Nike Kids Tracksuit Jacket - Black
description.tagline: FCB x Mamba style on and off the field
description.intro: The Nike 2a Barcelona Kobe Bryant Woven children's jacket fuses the identity of FC Barcelona with the legacy of Kobe Bryant in a garment designed to offer comfort, protection and exclusive style. Its black design with details from the Mamba collection reflects the competitive mentality that unites two sports icons.
key_benefits: Lightweight Woven Fabric: Provides comfort and protection without sacrificing mobility.
Loose fit: Encourages total freedom of movement.
Water-repellent finish: Protects against light rain and humidity.
FC Barcelona Design: Print inspired by the legacy of Kobe Bryant and the Blaugrana identity.
